info.name: Epic Wedplanner Auth and KYC API
info.description: Epic Wedplanner authentication, Cloudinary uploads, and manual KYC review. Import the matching Postman environment. Save each document number and upload its image in separate requests; both write to the same document row. Submit the company form last.

request.description: Copy the OTP from the email into emailOtp. Verification does not sign the user in.
Saves vendor access token, refresh token, and user ID to the active Postman environment.
Google ID token must be issued for GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. role is needed only for a new account.
Rotates the vendor refresh token and saves the new access and refresh tokens to the active environment.
Can also use the httpOnly refresh cookie.
Choose a local file in Postman. Allowed types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF. purpose can be kyc-pan, kyc-aadhaar, kyc-gst, kyc-cin, company-logo, avatar, favicon_icon, header_logo, or other.
Select a masked Aadhaar card image. Saves its Cloudinary URL as aadhaarUploadUrl.
Confirms that the authenticated vendor can access vendor-only routes.
Saves the PAN number to its KYC document row. Upload the matching image separately; either order works.
Saves the Aadhaar number to its KYC document row. Upload the matching image separately; either order works.
Saves the GSTIN number to its KYC document row. Upload the matching image separately; either order works.
Saves the CIN number to its KYC document row. Upload the matching image separately; either order works.

Final KYC form containing only business details not collected during registration. Save PAN and Aadhaar numbers via their existing endpoints and upload both card images first. GSTIN and CIN remain optional, but each optional document needs both its number and image.
Confirms that the authenticated admin can access admin-only routes.

item.name: Admin service catalog
item.description: Admin-only CRUD for service categories and subcategories. Run create requests first so their test scripts save IDs for later requests.

request.description: Creates a category. Only name is required. Optional fields: description, imageUrl, and imagePublicId. You may alternatively upload an image using multipart/form-data with a file field.
Returns one service category and its complete subcategories array.
Deletes the category and cascades to its subcategories. Run after subcategory requests.

Creates a subcategory. Required fields: name and serviceCategoryId. Optional fields: description, imageUrl, and imagePublicId. You may alternatively upload an image using multipart/form-data with a file field.
Confirms that the authenticated super admin can access super-admin-only routes.
